k-math-m1-a-1.title: Graphs of Piecewise Linear Functions
k-math-m1-a-1.description: Define appropriate quantities from physical situations, choose logical scales, and translate actions into piecewise graphs.

k-math-m1-a-2.title: Growth of Square Areas and Functions
k-math-m1-a-2.description: How do geometric figures grow? Contrast linear perimeter growth with quadratic area expansion using an interactive geometric workbench.

k-math-m1-a-3.title: Graphs of Exponential Functions
k-math-m1-a-3.description: What happens when a quantity doubles at every step? Explore the fundamental mathematical differences between linear addition (constant differences) and exponential multiplication (constant factors).

k-math-m1-a-4.title: Analyzing Graphs — Water Usage During a Typical School Day
k-math-m1-a-4.description: How does a physical building communicate through data? Examine cumulative volume graphs, interpret piecewise slopes, and calculate average rates of change across the rhythm of a high school day.

k-math-m1-a-5.title: Two Graphing Stories — Modeling Physical Motion
k-math-m1-a-5.description: Can a picture tell two different stories? Translate physical events into piecewise mathematical graphs and discover how slope reveals velocity, rest intervals, and elevation changes.

k-math-m1-b-1.title: Algebraic Expressions — The Distributive Property
k-math-m1-b-1.description: Master how the distributive property underpins algebraic equivalence and visual area models.

k-math-m1-b-2.title: Algebraic Expressions — Commutative & Associative Properties
k-math-m1-b-2.description: Prove expression equivalencies and justify term regrouping using commutative and associative identities.

k-math-m1-b-3.title: Adding and Subtracting Polynomials
k-math-m1-b-3.description: Understand polynomial structure, standard form, degree, and prove closure under addition and subtraction.

k-math-m1-b-4.title: Multiplying Polynomials
k-math-m1-b-4.description: Master tabular area multiplication (box method) and prove closure under polynomial multiplication.

k-math-m1-c-1.title: True and False Equations
k-math-m1-c-1.description: Understand equations as statements of equality with truth values, and identify solution sets.

k-math-m1-c-10.title: Rearranging Formulas
k-math-m1-c-10.description: Isolate specified variables in geometric, financial, and scientific literal equations.

k-math-m1-c-11.title: Solution Sets to Equations with Two Variables
k-math-m1-c-11.description: Understand that the graph of an equation in two variables is the set of all ordered pairs that satisfy it.

k-math-m1-c-12.title: Solution Sets to Inequalities with Two Variables
k-math-m1-c-12.description: Graph linear inequalities in two variables as shaded half-planes with solid or dashed boundary lines.

k-math-m1-c-13.title: Solution Sets to Simultaneous Equations (Part 1)
k-math-m1-c-13.description: Solve systems of linear equations graphically and algebraically using the substitution method.

k-math-m1-c-14.title: Solution Sets to Simultaneous Equations (Part 2)
k-math-m1-c-14.description: Prove why the elimination method works through linear combinations that preserve solution sets.

k-math-m1-c-2.title: Solution Sets for Equations and Inequalities
k-math-m1-c-2.description: Graph solution sets on the real number line using open/closed circles and directed rays.

k-math-m1-c-3.title: Solving Equations
k-math-m1-c-3.description: Understand equation solving as a deductive if-then process supported by properties of equality.

k-math-m1-c-4.title: Potential Dangers When Solving Equations
k-math-m1-c-4.description: Learn which algebraic operations are non-reversible and introduce extraneous solutions or lose valid roots.

k-math-m1-c-5.title: Solving Inequalities
k-math-m1-c-5.description: Master solving linear inequalities and prove why multiplying by negative numbers flips the relation.

k-math-m1-c-6.title: Solution Sets of Two or More Equations Joined by 'And' or 'Or'
k-math-m1-c-6.description: Understand conjunctions (And / Intersection) and disjunctions (Or / Union) in algebraic equations.

k-math-m1-c-7.title: Solving and Graphing Inequalities Joined by 'And' or 'Or'
k-math-m1-c-7.description: Solve compound inequalities and graph bounded intervals and disjoint rays on coordinate lines.

k-math-m1-c-8.title: Equations Involving Factored Expressions
k-math-m1-c-8.description: Solve quadratic and polynomial equations in factored form using the Zero-Product Property.

k-math-m1-c-9.title: Equations Involving a Variable in the Denominator
k-math-m1-c-9.description: Identify domain restrictions, avoid division by zero, and solve rational equations with extraneous root detection.

k-math-m1-d-1.title: Solving Problems in Two Ways — Rates and Algebra
k-math-m1-d-1.description: Compare intuitive arithmetic unit-rate solutions with formal algebraic modeling.

k-math-m1-d-2.title: Recursive Challenge: The Double and Add 5 Game (Part 1)
k-math-m1-d-2.description: Explore recurrence relations and recursive sequence modeling with the Double and Add 5 Game.

k-math-m1-d-3.title: Recursive Challenge: The Double and Add 5 Game (Part 2)
k-math-m1-d-3.description: Derive explicit closed-form formulas for recursive relations and solve target-seeking inequalities.

ged-m-1-1.title: Order of Operations & Absolute Value with Rational Numbers
ged-m-1-1.description: Master the hierarchy of arithmetic operations (PEMDAS / GEMDAS), absolute value distance properties, and operations with signed rational numbers for the GED Quantitative Reasoning test.

k-math-m1-c-15.title: Applications of Systems of Equations & Inequalities
k-math-m1-c-15.description: Model multi-constraint authentic problems with systems of equations and linear inequalities.

k-math-m1-d-4.title: Federal Income Tax — Piecewise Linear Modeling
k-math-m1-d-4.description: Model authentic federal income tax brackets as piecewise linear continuous functions.
